reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (lockfile_conflict seed 5 resolves to 'take_upstream', which accepts ['take_upstream'], but the program implements 'keep_local'); firing where a sibling resolution is correct is the mismatch this gate exists to refuse

refused_program.body:
set -euo pipefail

git fetch {upstream_remote}

if git merge {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} --no-edit; then
  exit 0
fi

if ! git ls-files -u -- deps.lock | grep -q .; then
  echo "deps.lock did not conflict; refusing to guess" >&2
  exit 1
fi

tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT

git show :1:deps.lock > "$tmpdir/base"
git show :2:deps.lock > "$tmpdir/ours"
git show :3:deps.lock > "$tmpdir/theirs"

extract_packages() {
  awk '
    /^[[:space:]]*packages[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*\[/ { in_packages=1; next }
    in_packages && /^[[:space:]]*\][[:space:]]*$/ { in_packages=0; next }
    in_packages { print }
  ' "$1"
}

extract_packages "$tmpdir/base" > "$tmpdir/base_pkgs"
extract_packages "$tmpdir/ours" > "$tmpdir/ours_pkgs"
extract_packages "$tmpdir/theirs" > "$tmpdir/theirs_pkgs"

: > "$tmpdir/local_only"
while IFS= read -r line; do
  if ! grep -Fqx -- "$line" "$tmpdir/base_pkgs"; then
    if ! grep -Fqx -- "$line" "$tmpdir/local_only"; then
      printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$tmpdir/local_only"
    fi
  fi
done < "$tmpdir/ours_pkgs"

: > "$tmpdir/upstream_only"
while IFS= read -r line; do
  if ! grep -Fqx -- "$line" "$tmpdir/base_pkgs"; then
    if ! grep -Fqx -- "$line" "$tmpdir/upstream_only"; then
      printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$tmpdir/upstream_only"
    fi
  fi
done < "$tmpdir/theirs_pkgs"

: > "$tmpdir/base_common"
while IFS= read -r line; do
  if grep -Fqx -- "$line" "$tmpdir/ours_pkgs" && grep -Fqx -- "$line" "$tmpdir/theirs_pkgs"; then
    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$tmpdir/base_common"
  fi
done < "$tmpdir/base_pkgs"

awk '!seen[$0]++' "$tmpdir/local_only" "$tmpdir/upstream_only" "$tmpdir/base_common" > "$tmpdir/resolved_pkgs"

awk -v pkgfile="$tmpdir/resolved_pkgs" '
  /^[[:space:]]*packages[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*\[/ {
    print
    while ((getline line < pkgfile) > 0) print line
    close(pkgfile)
    in_packages=1
    next
  }
  in_packages && /^[[:space:]]*\][[:space:]]*$/ {
    print
    in_packages=0
    next
  }
  in_packages { next }
  { print }
' "$tmpdir/theirs" > "$tmpdir/resolved"

cat "$tmpdir/resolved" > deps.lock
git add deps.lock
git commit --no-edit
